layer_3_action.subject: Corythosaurus
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Corythosaurus with smooth clay-like skin is splashing playfully in a large puddle. The camera angle is an exact side profile to clearly showcase its iconic tall, circular helmet-shaped crest standing out against the background. The scene is lush with Metasequoia trees, taxodium conifers, and floating Azolla ferns. No text.

layer_3_action.subject: Edmontosaurus
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Edmontosaurus with smooth clay-like skin is standing fully alert on its hind legs on a sandy riverbank. Its flat head is held horizontally, emphasizing its lack of a top crest and highlighting its exceptionally wide, spoon-shaped duckbill snout. The background features open river channels with low-lying palms, platanites, and viburnum shrubs under a humid hazy sky. No text.

layer_3_action.subject: Lambeosaurus
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Lambeosaurus with smooth clay-like skin is standing on a dark, muddy plain, tilting its head downward to look curiously at a bright Magnolia flower on the ground. The three-quarter profile clearly emphasizes the top-heavy hatchet shape of the crest leaning out over its face, contrasted with the distinct little spike sticking out the back of its skull. No text.

layer_3_action.subject: Maiasaura
features: small solid bony crest lump between the eyes
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Maiasaura with smooth clay-like skin is pacing across a dense green fern-meadow, bowing its head down to search for low-growing horsetails. The camera is positioned at a low three-quarter angle to clearly catch the distinct small, solid bony crest lump situated right between its eyes. The background features open floodplain woodland flats under a soft clear sky. No text.

layer_3_action.subject: Young Parasaurolophus
features: exceptionally long backward-curving hollow tube crest
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized young Parasaurolophus with smooth clay-like skin is wandering across a wide alluvial floodplain, reaching its head up high toward the sky. The camera angle captures a sweeping side silhouette to dramatically highlight its massive, uniquely long, backward-curving tube crest that sweeps far back past its neck. The background shows distant dense fern-meadows and muddy patches under soft studio lighting. No text.
